onboarding1_description: A smart attendance system using encrypted geofencing and automatically changing codes to prevent tampering.
onboarding1_feature1_description: Automatically check in when passing the workplace entrance, without manual scans or waiting in queues.
onboarding1_feature2_description: Reliable attendance detection inside enclosed floors and offices, even when GPS is unavailable.
onboarding2_description: An encrypted system links your account to your trusted phone and changing dynamic QR codes.
onboarding2_feature1_description: Blocks location spoofing apps (No Mock GPS / VPN Protected) to ensure you are physically within the permitted area.
onboarding2_feature2_description: Locks your account to your device ID to prevent proxy attendance or check-ins from replacement devices.
onboarding2_feature3_description: An encrypted code refreshes every 15 seconds to prevent screenshots or code sharing between employees.
onboarding3_title: Your self-service hub in one place
onboarding3_description: Track your salary, leave and permission requests, and interactive calendar with one touch.
onboarding3_feature1_description: Instant calculation of overtime hours and allowances.
onboarding3_feature2_description: Instant notifications when your manager and administration approve requests.
onboarding3_feature3_description: Direct connection to central human resources systems.
